Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryFccYieldBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryFccYieldBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryFccYieldBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable screening-level fluid catalytic cracking product-yield balance.

The calculation converts a caller-selected fraction of a hydrocarbon feed and allocates the converted feed among dry gas, liquefied petroleum gas, gasoline, light cycle oil, and coke. It is an algebraic scenario receipt, not a kinetic, riser, catalyst, deactivation, fractionation, or product-property model.

1.0

      Calculate a five-lump FCC converted-product balance plus unconverted oil.
      Parameters:
      feedMassFlowKgPerHour - hydrocarbon feed mass flow in kg/h
      conversionFraction - fraction of hydrocarbon feed converted, in [0, 1]
      dryGasMassFractionOfConvertedFeed - dry-gas fraction of converted feed

      gasolineMassFractionOfConvertedFeed - gasoline fraction of converted feed
      lightCycleOilMassFractionOfConvertedFeed - light-cycle-oil fraction of converted feed
      cokeMassFractionOfConvertedFeed - coke fraction of converted feed
      Returns:
      immutable FCC yield receipt
